Part of the analysis code for the matched liver–serum multi-omics study in MASLD. This script is self-contained: open it in RStudio (or `rmarkdown::render("Fig2_serum_metabolome.Rmd")` from this folder). It first loads the workspace of the previous step (`Hepatic_polar_metabolome`), running that script if needed. Input data are read from `data/` (see `data/README.md`); Supplementary Tables used here are in `Source_data/`; Source Data for this item are written to `Source_data/`; other outputs go to `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)

  d <- normalizePath(getwd())
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "common", "setup.R")) && dirname(d) != d) d <- dirname(d)
  d
}
source(file.path(.root, "common", "setup.R"))
```

# Serum metabolome: Table S10a and Fig. 2

Serum polar and semi-polar metabolomics (n = 209), and the Sankey diagram of liver and serum metabolites (Fig. 2).

#### Read Input Data and Subsetting Based on Gender for Downstream Analysis

```{r serummet-01, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
# Load description data
# Read the description data
exposures <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(project_dir, "Analysis_Serum_Polars_Semipolars/exposure_serum_polars_semipolars.xlsx")))
exposures <- t(exposures)
exposures <- data.frame(exposures)
colnames(exposures) <- exposures[1, ]
exposures <- exposures[-1, ]
clean_colnames <- function(colnames) {
  gsub("[^[:alnum:]_]", "_", colnames)
}
# Apply the function to the column names
colnames(exposures) <- clean_colnames(colnames(exposures))
clean_colnames <- function(colnames) {
  colnames <- gsub("___", "_", colnames)  # Replace triple underscores with single underscore
  colnames <- gsub("__", "_", colnames)   # Replace double underscores with single underscore
  return(colnames)
}
# Apply the function to the column names
colnames(exposures) <- clean_colnames(colnames(exposures))
phenotype_Serum <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(project_dir, "Analysis_Serum_Polars_Semipolars/Metadata_serum.xlsx")))
row.names(phenotype_Serum) <- phenotype_Serum$ID
phenotype_Serum <- phenotype_Serum %>%
  filter(!is.na(steatosis_Kleiner))
# Find common row names
common_rows <- intersect(rownames(exposures), rownames(phenotype_Serum))
# Subset exposures to keep only common rows
phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars <- phenotype_Serum[common_rows, , drop = FALSE]
# Subset exposures data based on the filtered phenotype data frames
exposures <- exposures[rownames(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars), , drop = FALSE]
# Ensure row names are aligned for both phenotype and exposures subsets
phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars <- phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars[rownames(exposures), , drop = FALSE]
# Validate alignment
table(row.names(exposures) == row.names(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars))
pfas_cols <- c("PFHxS", "PFNA", "PFOA", "PFOS_L", "PFOS_B")
exposures <- exposures[, !(colnames(exposures) %in% pfas_cols)]
# Clean phenotype data
phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars$Menopause_YN <- NULL
phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars <- phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars[, -((ncol(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars)-9):ncol(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars))]
subset_ids <- sub("LIV", "", rownames(phenotype))
phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars <- phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars[phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars$ID %in% subset_ids, ]
exposures <- exposures[rownames(exposures) %in% subset_ids, ]
table(row.names(exposures) == row.names(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars))
# Convert rownames to a column in the phenotype data frame
df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars, "SampleID")
min_value_GGT_UL <- min(df$GGT_UL, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GGT_UL[is.na(df$GGT_UL)] <- min_value_GGT_UL / 2
```

#### Data Normalization and Visualization

```{r serummet-02, fig.align='center', fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Create a POMA object
data <- POMA::PomaCreateObject(metadata = df, features = exposures)
# Impute missing data using half-minimum method
imputed <- data %>%
  PomaImpute(method = "half_min", zeros_as_na = TRUE, remove_na = TRUE, cutoff = 20)
log2_transformed <- imputed %>%
    PomaNorm(method = "log_transform")
# Normalize the data using log scaling
normalized <- log2_transformed %>%
  PomaNorm(method = "auto_scaling")
# Create boxplots for visualization before and after normalization
a <- PomaBoxplots(imputed, x = "samples") +
     ggplot2::ggtitle("Not Normalized") +
     ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank()) + theme(legend.position="none")
b <- PomaBoxplots(log2_transformed, x = "samples") +
     ggplot2::ggtitle("Log transformed") +
     ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank()) +  theme(legend.position="none")
c <- PomaBoxplots(normalized, x = "samples") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle("Auto scaling") +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank()) + theme(legend.position="none")
# Combine the plots for comparison
#a + b + c
b + c
```

## Prepare covariates and orientation for limma (serum)

```{r serummet-04, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# sample MF138 was removed from the expression matrix above; drop it from the covariates too
phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars <- phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars[rownames(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars) != "MF138", ]
exposures_Normalized <- t(exposures_Normalized)   # samples x metabolites
df <- phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars
df$ID <- NULL; df$ID_RM <- NULL
df$Gender_M0F1 <- ifelse(df$Gender_M0F1 == "Male", 0, 1)
df$Steatosis <- ifelse(df$steatosis_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Inflammation <- ifelse(df$inflammation_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Fibrosis <- ifelse(df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 == 0, 0, 1)
df$steatosis_Kleiner <- NULL; df$inflammation_Kleiner <- NULL; df$ballooning_Kleiner <- NULL
df$NASH_Kleiner_YN <- NULL; df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 <- NULL; df$NAS_score <- NULL
df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(Age = Age_yr, Gender = Gender_M0F1, BMI = BMI_kgm2, Glucose = Glucose_mgdL,
  HbA1c = HbA1c_percent, AST = AST_UL, ALT = ALT_UL, GGT = GGT_UL, Cholesterol = Cholesterol_mgdL,
  HDL = HDL_mgdL, LDL = LDL_mgdL, Triglycerides = TG_mgdL)
```

#### DEGs Metabolomics

```{r serummet-05}
# Transpose matrix: rows = metabolites, columns = samples
metabo_mat <- t(as.matrix(exposures_Normalized))
# Check dimensions
dim(metabo_mat)
# Should be: features x samples, e.g., 701 x 189
# Ensure column names match metadata rownames
all(colnames(metabo_mat) == rownames(df))  # should be TRUE
# Phenotype metadata
metadata <- df
metadata$Steatosis <- factor(metadata$Steatosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Inflammation <- factor(metadata$Inflammation, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Fibrosis <- factor(metadata$Fibrosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Gender <- factor(metadata$Gender, levels = c(0,1))  # 0 = Male, 1 = Female
# Differential analysis function
run_diff <- function(phenotype){
  design <- model.matrix(~ Age + BMI + Gender + metadata[[phenotype]], data = metadata)

  fit <- lmFit(metabo_mat, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)

  # Coefficient of interest = last column (phenotype effect)
  coef_name <- ncol(design)
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  return(res)
}
# Run for each phenotype
res_steatosis <- run_diff("Steatosis")
res_inflammation <- run_diff("Inflammation")
res_fibrosis <- run_diff("Fibrosis")
# Filter significant metabolites (FDR ≤ 0.10)
sig_steatosis <- res_steatosis[res_steatosis$adj.P.Val <= 0.1, ]
sig_inflammation <- res_inflammation[res_inflammation$adj.P.Val <= 0.1, ]
sig_fibrosis <- res_fibrosis[res_fibrosis$adj.P.Val <= 0.1, ]
# Add phenotype and direction columns for each condition
sig_steatosis_tbl_serum <- sig_steatosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Steatosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_steatosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)
sig_inflammation_tbl_serum <- sig_inflammation %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Inflammation",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_inflammation)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)
sig_fibrosis_tbl_serum <- sig_fibrosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Fibrosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_fibrosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)
# Combine all into a single table
combined_sig_tbl_serum <- bind_rows(sig_steatosis_tbl_serum, sig_inflammation_tbl_serum)
# Optional: sort by Phenotype and logFC
combined_sig_tbl_serum <- combined_sig_tbl_serum %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, desc(logFC))
combined_sig_tbl_serum$Tissue <- "Serum"
# View table
```

```{r serummet-06, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# keep the serum limma results for the EPoS comparison (Tables S19-S20)
serum_limma <- list(Steatosis = res_steatosis, Inflammation = res_inflammation, Fibrosis = res_fibrosis)
```

## Table S10a

```{r serummet-07, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
add_table("Table S10a", combined_sig_tbl_serum %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("Tissue")))
```

```{r serummet-08}
library(ggalluvial)
# 1️⃣ Read / define your serum and biopsy significant metabolite tables
# Example: combined_sig_tbl_serum and combined_sig_tbl_biopsy
# These should have at least: Metabolite, Phenotype, Direction, Tissue
# Here we assume you already have them as data frames
# 2️⃣ Combine serum and biopsy tables
combined_sig_tbl <- bind_rows(combined_sig_tbl_serum, combined_sig_tbl_biospy)
# 1️⃣ Clean metabolite names
combined_sig_tbl <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite = gsub("\\.\\.\\..*", "", Metabolite), # remove ...1 suffixes
    Metabolite = toupper(trimws(Metabolite))          # uppercase and trim spaces
  )
# 2️⃣ Create metabolite-to-pathway mapping
metabolite_pathway_map <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = c(
    # Amino acids
    "ISOLEUCINE", "LEUCIN", "GLUTAMINE", "GLUTAMIC_ACID",
    "TRYPTOPHAN", "TAURINE", "METHIONINE", "PHENYLALANINE",
    "VALINE", "THREONINE", "ASPARTIC_ACID", "LYSINE",
    "SERINE", "AMINOBUTYRIC_ACID", "X3_METHYL_2_OXOVALERATE",

    # Fatty acids / PUFA
    "ARACHIDONIC_ACID", "CIS_8_11_14_17_EICOSATETRAENOIC_ACID", "HDCA",

    # Bile acids
    "ALLO_DCA", "GCA", "TCA", "TDCA",

    # Nucleotides
    "INOSINE", "HYPOXANTHINE",

    # Carbohydrates / other
    "MANNOSE_MYOINOSITOL", "QUINATE", "GALACTURONIC_ACID",

    # Ketone bodies
    "X2_HYDROXYBUTYRIC_ACID_3_HYDROXYBUTYRIC_ACID",

    # Other / putative metabolites will be annotated as "Other" later
    "PUTATIVE_OXYPURINOL", "PUTATIVE_CINNAMIC_ACID",
    "PUTATIVE_TYROSOL_GLUCURONIDE_TYR_G",
    "PUTATIVE_N_2_HYDROXYPHENYL_ACETAMIDE_SULFATE_2_HPA_S",
    "PUTATIVE_P_COUMARIC_ACID_SULFATE_P_COU_S"
  ),
  Pathway = c(
    # Amino acids
    rep("Amino acid metabolism", 15),
    # Fatty acids
    rep("Fatty acid metabolism", 3),
    # Bile acids
    rep("Bile acid metabolism", 4),
    # Nucleotides
    rep("Nucleotide metabolism", 2),
    # Carbohydrates / other
    rep("Carbohydrate metabolism", 3),
    # Ketone bodies
    "Ketone metabolism",
    # Putative / other
    rep("Other", 5)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# 3️⃣ Left join with main table and assign "Other" to unknowns
combined_sig_tbl <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  left_join(metabolite_pathway_map, by = "Metabolite") %>%
  mutate(Pathway = ifelse(is.na(Pathway), "Other", Pathway))
# 4️⃣ Verify
table(combined_sig_tbl$Pathway)
# 2️⃣ Sankey input for Panel B
sankey_data <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
    filter(Pathway != "Other") %>%
    group_by(Tissue, Phenotype, Direction, Pathway) %>%
    summarise(Count = n_distinct(Metabolite), .groups = "drop")
sankey_data$Tissue <- factor(sankey_data$Tissue, levels = c("Biopsy", "Serum"))
sankey_data$Phenotype <- factor(sankey_data$Phenotype, levels = c("Inflammation", "Steatosis"))
sankey_data$Direction <- factor(sankey_data$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))
sankey_data$Pathway <- factor(sankey_data$Pathway, levels = c(
    "Amino acid metabolism",
    "Fatty acid metabolism",
    "Bile acid metabolism",
    "Nucleotide metabolism",
    "Carbohydrate metabolism",
    "Ketone metabolism"
))
final_sankey <- ggplot(
    sankey_data,
    aes(
        axis1 = Tissue,
        axis2 = Phenotype,
        axis3 = Direction,
        axis4 = Pathway,
        y = Count
    )
) +
    geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Direction), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.8, color = "gray40") +
    geom_stratum(width = 0.25, fill = "grey95", color = "black") +
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#FFA500", "Down" = "#4575B4")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Tissue", "Phenotype", "Direction", "Pathway")) +
    labs(
        title = "Metabolite Regulation Across MASLD Features",
        y = "Number of Metabolites",
        x = NULL,
        fill = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
# 4️⃣ Show plot
final_sankey
```

```{r serummet-09}
# ---- Prepare Sankey data ----
sankey_data <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  filter(Pathway != "Other") %>%
  group_by(Tissue, Phenotype, Direction, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(Count = n_distinct(Metabolite), .groups = "drop")
# ---- Factor ordering ----
sankey_data$Tissue <- factor(sankey_data$Tissue, levels = c("Biopsy", "Serum"))
sankey_data$Phenotype <- factor(sankey_data$Phenotype, levels = c("Steatosis", "Inflammation"))
sankey_data$Direction <- factor(sankey_data$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))
sankey_data$Pathway <- factor(
  sankey_data$Pathway,
  levels = c(
    "Amino acid metabolism",
    "Fatty acid metabolism",
    "Bile acid metabolism",
    "Carbohydrate metabolism",
    "Ketone metabolism",
    "Nucleotide metabolism"
  )
)
# ---- Wrapped labels for pathways ----
sankey_data$Pathway_wrapped <- str_wrap(as.character(sankey_data$Pathway), width = 16)
# ---- Final Sankey plot ----
final_sankey <- ggplot(
  sankey_data,
  aes(
    axis1 = Tissue,
    axis2 = Phenotype,
    axis3 = Pathway_wrapped,
    y = Count
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = Direction),
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.85,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.38,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 3.0,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Up" = "#FFA500", "Down" = "#4575B4"),
    guide = guide_legend(title = "Regulation")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Tissue", "Phenotype", "Pathway")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Number of metabolites",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 25, 5, 25)
  )
# ---- Render ----
final_sankey
```
